description: `break` and `continue` come from SystemVerilog; Verilog-A loops have no early exit. Until 2.33.0 this was reported as an assignment missing its `=`.
actions: For `break`: fold the exit into the loop condition, e.g. `for (i = 0; i < n && !done; i = i + 1)` and set `done = 1` where the `break` was.
For `continue`: wrap the rest of the loop body in `if (!skip) begin ... end`.
